[1/1] Fix reforge stage 9 finding: the judge child writes its whole result with one fs.writeSync, which on a POSIX pipe can write part of it or throw EAGAIN. Write all bytes in a loop (retry EAGAIN with a 1 ms wait, rethrow other errors), built from functions captured before the answer runs; test it with a fake write that is partial and throws EAGAIN; re-judge saved answers old vs new; tune:gate.

impact_assessment.why: Reforge run-1 stage 9 recorded the finding; results grew from a few bytes to MBs with ADR-115/117, so a short write now loses the end marker
impact_assessment.benefits: Large correct results survive a non-blocking or small pipe on macOS and Linux
impact_assessment.risks: contract: how the child emits its result changes, so scores could change if the loop were wrong; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: gate cache digest changes with suite.mjs
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests with a fake write; all saved answers re-judged old vs new in one run; tune:gate; Windows end-to-end tests unchanged
